_comment: A passive that reflects fire damage back at anything that hits the caster, 3 HP plus 1 per level, even when the hit was fully absorbed. The reflect is raw authored damage: it does not scale with character level, crit chance, lifesteal, or any power-scaling passive. No cost, since there is nothing to charge the victim of a hit for retaliating. All values placeholder.
name: FireShield
description: Being hit is enough - it fires even when the hit is fully absorbed.
